summary: The authors’ hypothalamic genotype coefficient compares WT with Ube3a 2x in females. HypoExplorer estimates a common Ube3a 2x versus WT effect across both sexes. The gene-level genotype table in the journal supplement covers prefrontal cortex, and the public hypothalamic results do not supply the registered contrast.

manualReview.summary: The deposited hypothalamus samples match the registered cohort. The authors’ genotype result is female-specific.
manualReview.note: All 18 registered hypothalamus samples match GEO mouse, genotype and sex assignments. The released limma-voom model includes genotype by sex, RIN and two surrogate variables. Its genotype contrast selects groupWT alone, giving WT versus Ube3a 2x at the female reference level. Figure S4F and the single reported Ube3a discovery follow that contrast. The registered edgeR-QL fit includes sex and a common genotype coefficient. Table S3 has the same Ensembl IDs as the explicitly prefrontal Table S1, and replay of the published tissue filters confirms the prefrontal assignment.
reviewFlags: The published Ube3a discovery and the registered Ube3a discovery concern different genotype effects. The female coefficient cannot establish pooled effect direction, magnitude or inference.

evidenceLinks.label: Journal supplementary Figure S4 and Tables S1–S6
Authors’ genotype and interaction contrast definitions

verificationReview.reason: The hypothalamic genotype test selects groupWT from a genotype-by-sex model with sexM and groupWT:sexM. It estimates WT versus Ube3a 2x within females. Reversing its sign still yields a female-specific coefficient. HypoExplorer’s registered Ube3a 2x versus WT coefficient assumes a common effect across females and males. Tables S1–S3 have the prefrontal feature set, and the preprint and public analysis archive supply no hypothalamic result for the registered contrast.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if a gene-level hypothalamic Ube3a 2x versus WT effect across both sexes becomes available with its contrast weights or common-effect model definition, sample IDs and reported statistics.

Ube3a is the sole discovery among 20,348 published IDs. Its case-minus-WT log2FC is 2.17972725094453, raw P is 2.10137121659142e-09 and adjusted P is 4.34752691000598e-05.

openIssues: A gene-level hypothalamic result for a common or explicitly sex-averaged genotype effect remains unavailable in the reviewed public sources. Its effect sizes, P values and FDR remain unassessed for author concordance.
